focus: Request admission and ambiguous acknowledgement; narrow delta side effects

findings.issue: Transient 4xx rejection of an explicit repeat clears an earlier unresolved admission identity
findings.reproduction: Original POST acknowledgement lost; same-ID explicit repeat returns transient409; controller clears recovery identity and admits changed intent with a new ID while original delayed POST may still arrive.
findings.repair_direction: Do not treat rejection of an ambiguous repeat as a definitive disposition of every earlier POST. Retain the original ID until persisted reconciliation or another explicit terminal protocol fact.

controller_checks.assertion: Early absence must retain the in-flight admission identity

limitations: Controlled VM/fetch interleaving does not execute delayed real HTTP admission
No browser/full suite rerun; concurrent aggregate/interaction qualification owns them
No real model capability or quality qualification
